faq_items.question: Where can I find free printable boho wall art?
faq_items.answer: You can download free printable boho wall art as high-resolution PDF files and print them at home or at a copy shop. Look for files built at 300 DPI and sized to standard frames, like the Biolex boho sun and moon print, so they come out crisp instead of blurry on paper.

faq_items.question: What size should I print boho wall art?
faq_items.answer: It depends on the wall. An 8x10 or 11x14 works for gallery-wall pieces and smaller spots like a nightstand, while a 16x20 or 18x24 makes a statement over a sofa or bed. Print the small sizes at home and send larger ones to a print shop on matte poster stock.

faq_items.question: What paper is best for printing wall art at home?
faq_items.answer: Heavyweight matte paper looks the most professional. Skip standard 20 lb copy paper and use 32 lb presentation paper or a matte photo paper around 45-65 lb. Set your printer to Best or Photo quality and turn off fit-to-page scaling so the art keeps its true proportions.

faq_items.question: How do I arrange a boho gallery wall?
faq_items.answer: Start with an odd number of prints and one larger anchor piece, then build outward. Keep a shared warm color palette, vary the subjects, and lay everything on the floor first to test spacing, about 2-3 inches between frames. Mixing wood, black, and rattan frames looks intentional, not mismatched.

faq_items.question: Can I print boho wall art at a print shop?
faq_items.answer: Yes. Save the printable PDF and upload it to an online print service or take it to a local copy shop. Ask for matte poster stock in your chosen size, such as 16x20 or 18x24. Because the file is free, you only pay for the print, far less than a boutique piece costs.
